contacts.note: Every number is derived from sealed bytes already on disk. The cosine scores are inner products between two sealed vector files; no encoder was run. Token counts come from the sealed MODEL_RESPONSE usage fields and the sealed MODEL_WIRE_RESPONSE timings; no tokenizer was run.

gold_use: SLURP TRAIN annotations joined OFFLINE for the diagnostics only. No utterance text, filler surface or gold sentence is printed or persisted; text comparisons run on SHA-256 digests of the lower-cased stripped string.

method.block_token_cost: paired difference of the sealed Solver-contact prompt_tokens between the B1 arm and the sealed anchor on the same row, restricted to the 816 rows whose non-exemplar evidence composition and character count match exactly, so the difference is the exemplar block and nothing else
method.chars_per_token: derived from that same paired difference by least squares through the origin of block characters on block tokens
method.prefill: timings.prompt_n and timings.cache_n of the sealed wire replies
method.retrieval_scores: cosine between the two sealed vector files, recomputed here

reconciliation: The decision-48 index design (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-knowledge-index-and-context-assembly-design.md, merged 12835d94) measured the same sealed arm on the first 20 distinct rows in flight order. Reproduced here on that window to within 0.05 / 0.13 / 0.81 percent for slot-contracts / intent-boundaries / train-exemplars. The full-roster figures in this receipt are the ones to quote.

section13_to_15_cards.prompt_order_note: rendering measured from the sealed MODEL_REQUEST payload; each supplied-evidence item renders as '[evidence <id>] <content>' under either speech-feature prompt order

index_design_reported.basis: median over the first 20 distinct rows in flight order
